content: REQUIRED DOCUMENTATION FOR AUTOMATION: 1. PRD (trigger, action, SLA). 2. Workflow Design (nodes, branches, error paths). 3. Integration Contracts (APIs, auth, idempotency). 4. Data Mapping Spec. 5. Secrets Management. 6. Error Handling & Retry Policy. 7. Observability. 8. DFDs. 9. Workflow Security Policy. 10. DR & Fallback. 11. Incident Response. 12. Runbooks. 13. Audit Reports. 14. Dependency Analysis.
